m: प्रा—बल्य n. (fr. -बल) superiority of power, predominance, ascendency, Vedāntas.; Suśr.
force, validity (of a rule), TPrāt., Sch.
प्राबल्य &c. See under 3. प्रा, p. 702, col. 2.
a: प्राबल्यं — 1 Ascendancy, superiority, predominance. --2 Power, force, might.

m: प्रा—बोधक m. = (and v.l. for) प्र-ब्˚, a minstrel employed to wake the king in the morning, R.
a: प्राबोध(धि)कः — 1 Dawn, daybreak. --2 A minstrel whose duty it is to wake the king in the morning by singing appropriate songs.
